about: The first huddle-drafter lessons (issue 848), from Dan's 2026-09-30 huddle post against the draft the board raised at 11:31 that day (huddle_drafts/2026-09-30T113145). His post matched the 12:37 redraft word for word, so that pair teaches nothing. Pass `writes` to one ArtifactData batch on the Day Board; each row lands proposed and waits for his Keep.

data.text: Never trim a line of his last focus while Today's focus has fewer than three lines; trim only past three.

source.change: focus: the draft dropped one of his focus lines as trimmed and kept two; he kept three

data.text: When a line of his last post is dropped as done, the report carries that outcome as its own line.

source.change: report: the draft dropped a risk of his as done but reported nothing for it; his post reported the outcome

data.text: Merge outcomes for the same partner into one report line that names each outcome.

source.change: report: the draft reported one answer to a partner; his post put the form he sent and the answer to that partner on one line

data.text: An overdue task that holds a named person up is a risk line: "[who] is waiting on [what]; [what] can't move until [action]".

source.change: risks: his post added three lines for overdue tasks where a named person waits, each in that form

data.text: Name people by first name only, and say who a sent item went to.

source.change: report: the draft gave a contact's full name and said what was sent but not to whom; his post used the first name and named the recipient
